studio.heroSubtitle: Karsa Studio is the space in between — where a business intention becomes a working digital product.
studio.philosophyBody: Karsa Studio helps businesses build, improve, and digitalize products and processes through a combination of business understanding, thoughtful design, and reliable technology. Business explains why something is built. Design shapes how people use and feel it. Technology makes sure it works — reliably, maintainably, and ready to grow.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Karsa Studio collects, uses, and stores information submitted through this website.
privacy.whatWeCollectBody: When you submit the Start a Project form, we collect the information you provide directly: name, email address, company (optional), phone (optional), the service you're inquiring about, budget range (optional), timeline (optional), your project description, and how you heard about us (optional).
privacy.whyWeCollectBody: This information is used solely to evaluate your project inquiry, respond to you, and — if we move forward — to scope and deliver the engagement. We don't use it for unrelated marketing without your separate consent.
privacy.storageBody: Submitted inquiries are stored in a Supabase-hosted database accessible only to Karsa Studio. Your submission also triggers two emails: one internal notification to Karsa, and one confirmation email sent to the address you provided.
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: We rely on a small number of third-party services to operate this website and process inquiries:
thirdPartyItems: A database provider, to store submitted inquiries.
A transactional email provider, to deliver notification and confirmation emails.
A bot-protection service, to verify that form submissions come from a real visitor.
privacy.thirdPartyOutro: These providers process data on our behalf and are not permitted to use it for their own purposes.
privacy.analyticsBody: We may use privacy-conscious website analytics to understand how the site is used. Analytics events never include your email, phone number, or project description.
privacy.yourDataBody: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of the information you've submitted at any time by contacting us.
